boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Stevens traditions that mark campus spirit, milestones, service and student creativity.

cards.title: Learn the Duck Dance
cards.subtitle: Orientation and athletics tradition
cards.notes: Learn the moves during orientation, then look for the dance at athletic events and other Stevens festivities.
cards.short_summary: A campus dance taught to first-year students and carried into Stevens celebrations.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevens says students learn the Duck Dance at orientation and perform it at athletic events and other festivities.
cards.source_title: Campus Traditions | Stevens Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: Participation details depend on the specific orientation or event.

cards.title: Walk Wittpenn Twice
cards.subtitle: Convocation-to-senior-year milestone
cards.notes: Cheer for first-years at fall Convocation, or join the senior walk toward the sunset gathering before graduation.
cards.short_summary: A procession that bookends an undergraduate student’s time at Stevens.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevens documents first-years walking up Wittpenn Walk at Convocation and seniors walking it again before graduation.
cards.source_title: Campus Traditions | Stevens Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: The first-year and senior portions occur at different points in the academic year.

cards.title: Quack or Treat
cards.subtitle: Campus Halloween tradition
cards.notes: Wear a costume if you choose, then follow the event information to participating campus locations for treats and activities.
cards.short_summary: A day-long Stevens Halloween event with costumes and campus-wide treat stops.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevens describes Quack or Treat as a day-long Halloween event where students collect treats at campus locations.
cards.source_title: Campus Traditions | Stevens Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: Check Student Affairs announcements for the current date and participating locations.

cards.title: Winter Wonderland
cards.subtitle: Late-fall campus celebration
cards.notes: Check Entertainment Committee programming in November or December for the lighting, music, desserts and giveaways.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal campus event built around lights, hot chocolate, music and holiday activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevens lists Winter Wonderland as a holiday event with lights, hot chocolate, desserts, giveaways and live music.
cards.source_title: Campus Traditions | Stevens Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: The event is sponsored by the Entertainment Committee; timing is listed as November or December.

cards.title: MLK Week of Service
cards.subtitle: January service tradition
cards.notes: Choose a published service project, talk or dialogue session, and review registration details before the January program begins.
cards.short_summary: A week of service, dialogue and recognition centered on Martin Luther King Jr.’s legacy.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevens says its January MLK Week of Service includes hands-on projects, speakers, dialogue and an oratorical contest awards dinner.
cards.source_title: Campus Traditions | Stevens Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: Activities and registration needs vary by year and by individual program.

cards.title: Founder's Day Ball
cards.subtitle: Student-only semiformal
cards.notes: Watch for the February announcement, then follow the current event guidance for entry, attire and student eligibility.
cards.short_summary: A semiformal marking the anniversary of Stevens’ founding on February 15, 1870.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevens identifies the Founder's Day Ball as a student-only semiformal commemorating the institute's February 15, 1870 founding.
cards.source_title: Campus Traditions | Stevens Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: This is described by Stevens as a student-only event; confirm current access instructions.

cards.title: Duck Days
cards.subtitle: Early-spring pride week
cards.notes: Check the spring schedule and pick from the listed activities, which may include a scavenger hunt, talent show or ice skating.
cards.short_summary: A week-long spring celebration of Stevens pride with changing activity programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevens describes Duck Days as an early-spring, week-long celebration with activities including scavenger hunts, talent shows and ice skating.
cards.source_title: Campus Traditions | Stevens Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: Specific activities and dates vary each spring.

cards.title: TechFest
cards.subtitle: Annual Entertainment Committee festival
cards.notes: Follow Entertainment Committee and Student Organizations updates for the April lineup, location and admission instructions.
cards.short_summary: An annual music festival coordinated by Stevens’ Entertainment Committee.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevens describes TechFest as an annual festival coordinated by the Entertainment Committee that brings music performers to campus.
cards.source_title: Campus Traditions | Stevens Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: Stevens lists the event in April; verify the current event details before attending.

cards.title: Innovation Expo
cards.subtitle: Spring student-project showcase
cards.notes: Use the Expo program to choose presentations, competitions or performances and plan time to see student work in person.
cards.short_summary: A spring showcase for student design, innovation and entrepreneurship projects.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevens calls Innovation Expo its annual spring showcase of student design, innovation and entrepreneurship.
cards.source_title: Campus Traditions | Stevens Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: Consult the current Innovation Expo program for venues, times and attendance information.

cards.title: Unity Showcase and Carnival
cards.subtitle: Cultural organizations’ performance tradition
cards.notes: Check the student-organizations calendar for the program, then attend performances by participating cultural organizations.
cards.short_summary: A campus showcase of student cultural organizations through dance, skits and music.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevens says cultural organizations use the Unity Showcase and Carnival for dances, skits and musical performances celebrating diversity and culture.
cards.source_title: Campus Traditions | Stevens Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: Program schedule and participating organizations vary by event cycle.
